answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
